row: gemm_correctness_followups (fast tree GEMM + FFN / LM-head adapters)

env.python_env: ~/envs/vllm (vLLM 0.31.0 env; Megatron env not needed for this row)

commands.before_tree: git archive 6a61f6e rl_engine tests/models/muse_glimmer extracted to $SCRATCH/before_tree (base commit code)
commands.tests_new_on_base_commit: cp the three new test files into $SCRATCH/before_tree/tests/models/muse_glimmer/; cd $SCRATCH/before_tree; PYTHONPATH=$SCRATCH/before_tree ~/bin/gpu-lease -n 1 --pool 4-5 --timeout 1800 -- ~/envs/vllm/bin/python -m pytest <same three files> -q -p no:cacheprovider --tb=line --rootdir=$SCRATCH/before_tree

headline: det_gemm:1: with 32/64-wide K chunks Triton folded the tree adds into the MMA chain (3 of 7 adds left); 48-67 % of outputs differed from the declared tree for K=256/512, k/v-proj dA and dW at 32 < T <= 512. Fixed (>= 2 BLOCK_K iterations, static assert, TTGIR guard): 0 mismatches.
det_gemm:2: rank-local autograd at TP2/4/8 differs from TP1 in 37-41 % of dA elements; the new column/row-parallel autograd shards (fp32 sub-tree partials + canonical tree) give 0 mismatches.
No Muse-Glimmer forward output changed (bit ledger: 101/101 forward hashes equal); 53/126 backward hashes changed, all in the shapes listed in findings[].bits_changed.
FFN backward now works for any T (was ValueError for T % 256 != 0); lm_head fwd+bwd at T=4001: 975.6 -> 405.6 ms; FFN fwd+bwd T=4096: 87.9 -> 79.3 ms.

findings.evidence: Triton 3.7.1, A100: with CHUNK_LEN == BLOCK_K the TTIR has 0 scf.for, 8 tt.dot of which 4 take the previous chunk's dot as accumulator, 3 fp32 tree addf (expected 7); PTX 96 add.f32 vs 224. Kernel vs declared tree (8 single-chunk launches + combine_tree): K=256 M=256 47419/98304 outputs differ, K=512 65600/98304, k_proj dA (N=256) M=4096 13188190/27262976, dW T=256/300/512 190301/214164/262455 of 393216; K>=768 equal. After: BLOCK_K lowered to give >=2 iterations, static assert, TTGIR guard (7 adds verified); 0 mismatches everywhere; IR identical in structure to the K=4096 kernel.
findings.fix: plan_chunks halves BLOCK_K until chunk_len/BLOCK_K >= 2 (min 16); tl.static_assert(ITERS >= 2); _verify_tree_ir checks NUM_CHUNKS-1 fp32 adds in the TTGIR once per compiled variant (TreeIRError, explicit opt-out env recorded in trace)
findings.bits_changed: dA of k_proj/v_proj (all T); dW for 32 < T <= 512 tokens (all weights); no forward output changed (bit ledger: 101/101 forward hashes equal)

findings.evidence: naive rank-local autograd (8 chunks over N_local, bf16 dA, summed) differs from TP1 in 37-41% of dA elements (q_proj M=256 TP2/4/8: 639150/686487/703717 of 1703936; k_proj, attn_gate, mlp_gate, up_proj alike). column_parallel_fast_det_gemm: 0 mismatches on every rank at TP2/4/8 for the 5 column-parallel shapes; row_parallel_fast_det_gemm: 0 mismatches in forward, dA, dW for o_proj/down_proj at TP2/4/8 (left fold of the same partials: 28-87 mismatches at TP4/8).
findings.fix: column_parallel_fast_det_gemm / column_parallel_da_partial / row_parallel_fast_det_gemm / tree_reduce_over_ranks (rank-ordered all-gather + runtime.tp_canonical_tree.combine_tree); fp32 sub-tree partials, one bf16 rounding; tp>1 without a reduce raises

findings.evidence: before: hasattr(fast_det_gemm, 'trace') False -> swiglu/reference model traces got a 3-key stub (test AttributeError on base commit)
findings.fix: fast_det_gemm.trace = trace; fast_det_gemm.name = OP_NAME

findings.evidence: dY -> bf16 cast in the backward (incl. fp32-out path) was undeclared in the contract and trace
findings.fix: declared in trace()['grad_cast'] and the module docstring; contract wording proposed (O3 backward: dY enters the backward GEMMs as bf16, one rounding). Behaviour unchanged: the bf16 MMA requires bf16 operands

findings.evidence: trace() had no k_chunks parameter, no GPU arch / Triton version
findings.fix: trace(m_size, out_dtype, k_chunks); runtime {device_name, device_capability, triton, torch} once CUDA is initialised; k_rule, block_k_rule, da_chunk_rule, min_chunk_iters, tree_ir_guard

findings.evidence: code inspection: Triton 3.7.1 runtime/jit.py:713-714 launches on driver.active.get_current_device()/get_current_stream; tree_gemm had no device guard. Not reproduced on hardware (needs two visible GPUs; this row leases one).
findings.fix: launch inside torch.cuda.device(a.device) when the operands are not on the current device
tests: test_launch_follows_operand_device (NOT RUN: skipped, needs 2 visible GPUs)

findings.evidence: test compared forward_fp32 to the identical expression
findings.fix: replaced by an explicit ascending-k fp64 loop + strict kernel within the fp32 tolerance of it

findings.evidence: base commit: default-GEMM FFN backward with weight grads raised ValueError ('reduction length 64 is not a multiple of 256 ... out of contract for the forward GEMM') for T = 1, 64, 255, 300, 4001 (benchmark + tests on base commit); T=256/4096 worked
findings.fix: dW GEMMs pass ragged_k=True (declared token rule T_pad = roundup(T,256), masked rows); any T >= 1

findings.evidence: base commit: trace()['tile_config']['gemm'] == {op, impl, kernel} only (test assert 'det_gemm' == 'muse_glimmer.fast_det_gemm' fails)
findings.fix: _FastDetGemm.trace() -> det_gemm.trace()

findings.evidence: base commit: adapter computed K=36 as a single chunk silently (test 'DID NOT RAISE ValueError')
findings.fix: ValueError for K % 8 != 0 unless ragged_k=True (same ragged rule as fast_det_gemm, bitwise equal)

findings.evidence: base commit, subprocess with ops.det_gemm blocked in sys.modules: default_gemm() returned TritonDetGemmAdapter silently ('SILENT TritonDetGemmAdapter')
findings.fix: det_gemm imported at module level; no implicit fallback; adapter explicit-only

findings.evidence: real-shape G2 pinned the adapter (coverage gap; invariance itself held on the base commit)
findings.fix: G2 parametrised over (adapter, default) incl. T=1/16/64/65 class slices; adapter == default bitwise at T=256 real shape

findings.evidence: _FastDetGemm called .contiguous() on both operands (transposed weight copies in every backward)
findings.fix: strided views passed through; FFN fwd+bwd T=4096 and peak memory measured before/after in the JSON

findings.evidence: profiler, no-grad forward T=32: base commit 2 cudaStreamSynchronize + 2 _local_scalar_dense; after 1 + 1; validate_targets=False 0 + 0
findings.fix: single host check; validate_targets=False: no sync, NaN logp for out-of-range targets (device-side), valid rows bitwise unchanged

findings.evidence: base commit: dW at T % 256 != 0 used legacy_det_gemm_fp32 (dW(T) != dW(zero-padded) for T=40,255,300); fwd+bwd T=4001 975.6 ms vs 455.0 ms at T=4096
findings.fix: dW = gemm(dz_t^T, h, ragged_k=True); legacy branch removed; no transposed copies

findings.evidence: base commit trace: reduction_order.gemm 'K walked in block order', no GEMM tile constants
findings.fix: trace()['gemm'] = det_gemm.trace(out_dtype=fp32); real reduction order incl. dh/dW rules

findings.evidence: base commit, subprocess with ops.det_gemm blocked: module imported and resolved the legacy GEMM ('SILENT ..._triton_gemm_fp32')
findings.fix: eager import, failure propagates; legacy only as explicit gemm=

findings.evidence: O7 backward text names no cast for dz; code and trace()['casts']['dz'] already declare fp32 -> bf16 once (required by R1 bf16 MMA operands)
findings.fix: contract edit only (docs/contracts is read-only for this row): O7 backward 'dz (fp32) -> bf16 once (RNE), then dh = det_gemm(dz, W_lm), dW_lm = det_gemm(dz^T, h)'

findings.evidence: every test T sent dW to the legacy kernel; no backend assertion
findings.fix: small geometry H=256 (fast path everywhere), backend assertion, real-shape backward at T=256/300 through the fast dW path, dW rule test

findings.evidence: REPORT described legacy numbers / untested switch; tanh test samples (1<<22)+(1<<20)+7 = 5242887, not 5e7
findings.fix: REPORT follow-up section + [stale] markers

findings.evidence: fp32 golden uses torch.mv (cuBLAS gemv)
findings.fix: documented: fp64 mode is THE R4 golden (docstring + trace()['golden']); fp32 mode is a tolerance convenience

megatron_binding_lm_head_tp_test.root_cause: test helper RecordReplayComm: in the record pass all_gather returns the rank's own tensor for every peer, so the forward logZ of the record pass is wrong and the dh partials it records for the peers (used in the replay pass) were computed with that wrong logZ; a second record pass that replays the correct forward gathers fixes it
